lastCompletedStory.title: Merge off-convention orch-recycle-watch tests into the canonical file and delete the original

nextStoryContext: US-001 (CAM-169) is done: the 11 off-convention tests from test/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts were carried verbatim into test/commands/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts inside a new describe('orch-recycle-watch (carried from off-convention suite)') block, imports retargeted to ../../src/..., and the off-convention file deleted. Combined file now has 28 top-level test() calls (17 canonical + 11 carried). Per acceptance criteria, the carried tests keep their own runOneTick helper + '__stop_loop__' sentinel; the canonical runWatcher helper + '__test_stop__' sentinel were left untouched and the semantic overlaps between the two suites were NOT deduped. All gates green: typecheck ok, bun test 4853 pass / 0 fail, bun run check:all fully clean.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Test-only file move/merge within bun:test; docs check performed against Bun's writing-tests guide to confirm describe/test grouping semantics matched the merge approach (multiple sibling describe blocks, no name collisions) -- aligned, no code change needed.
